csv_scope_of_work: City of Winter Park ("City") is seeking a qualified and responsible progressive designbuild team to reimagine and remodel an existing Parks Department equipment storage building into a new columbarium facility that will serve the adjacent Palm Cemetery. The City is seeking to maximize the number of niche units that may be provided through both interior and exterior improvements to the building and grounds. The columbarium facility will serve as a focal point within the cemetery, providing a dignified final resting place for cremated remains and meeting the needs of our community. The Selected Respondent will be responsible for all aspects of the construction process, including, but not limited to, design, site preparation, foundation work, remodel and construction of the columbarium structure, demo and removal, landscaping, and obtaining any necessary permits.
